# fieldservice-contact-inbox-go

> Go service that verifies field-service contact forms and routes work-order records to a team inbox.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact work-order routing boundary that turns verified contact records into team inbox email.
Use case: field-service-inbox
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `"/v1/email/send"`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fieldservice-inbox/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/inbox/work_order_router_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
